title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Detention Day Rates for Special Equipment
content:
A detention day priced at special-class rates costs the billed party the following, per container, under the Demurrage and Detention Free Time products (US dollars):

| | Slab 1 | Slab 2 | Slab 3 | Slab 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | 95.00 | 150.00 | 220.00 | 300.00 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | 95.00 | 150.00 | 220.00 | 300.00 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | 95.00 | 150.00 | 220.00 | 300.00 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | 95.00 | 150.00 | 220.00 | 300.00 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | 95.00 | 150.00 | 220.00 | 300.00 |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | 76.00 | 120.00 | 176.00 | 240.00 |

**Q: Is the contract scale a fixed saving on every slab?**
In money terms the gap grows with the slab: 19.00 in slab 1, 30.00 in slab 2, 44.00 in slab 3 and 60.00 in slab 4, each being the tariff figure less the contract figure in the table.

Hypothetical illustration: two special detention days in slab 4 under AHL Contract Free Time 30 total 480.00.
